t2.thesis: QCOM goes into the print after a sharp 11.6% five-day drop and 34% below its 52-week high, so the bar looks lowered, but the semis base rate, an industry-wide input-cost and memory squeeze on handsets, and a weak sector tape (Intel's guide, AMD's slide) leave the outcome roughly a coin flip, tilted slightly down.
reasons: The semis cluster base rate is below 50% (0.479), against ~0.54 for buying every event.
Price momentum into the print is very weak: -11.6% over 5 days and -9.9% over 1 month. That implies low expectations and some room for a relief bounce.
The December-quarter guide is exposed to higher memory and input costs, which could cut handset builds; Apple modem revenue is also fading faster than planned.
ATM call IV is above put IV (+0.09) and put/call OI is 0.79, so options positioning leans mildly bullish.
Consensus EPS of 2.16 sits at the midpoint of the 2.05-2.25 guide and revisions are slightly negative, so a small beat is likely but probably already priced.
t2.deciding_variable: The FQ1'27 (December quarter) revenue and EPS guide against consensus, especially handset QCT revenue under memory-driven build cuts, plus gross-margin commentary on pricing pass-through.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (n=434), checked against overall ~0.54 and AMC 0.538; semis is the closest peer group, so it is weighted most

t2.leak_probe: I can't know that yet: today is 2026-11-03, so Qualcomm's November 4, 2026 earnings report and the stock's reaction haven't happened.
t2.moved_from_prior: Up about +0.01 net. The oversold run-up into the print, the relatively bullish options skew and low short interest add about +0.03. The memory and input-cost guide risk and sector weakness in semis/PC subtract about -0.02.

theses.mechanism: The stock is washed out after a 12% drop in 5 days. An in-line or better December guide plus concrete data-center and Amazon progress triggers a relief rally.
theses.wrong_if: The guide midpoint lands below consensus or handset revenue is guided down sharply.

theses.mechanism: Memory shortages cut Android OEM builds and Apple share fades, so the December handset guide disappoints and margin pressure persists.
theses.wrong_if: QCT handset guide is flat or up sequentially and gross margin guides higher.

theses.mechanism: Results and guide come in near consensus. The stock drifts with the semis tape and macro (midterms, jobs data), and the move stays within the ~8.8% implied move.
theses.wrong_if: A large surprise in guide or data-center bookings drives a move bigger than the implied move.

key_observations: FQ1'27 revenue guide vs. consensus, and the QCT handset guide
Gross margin trajectory and progress on passing input costs through to pricing
Data-center revenue timing, the Amazon warrant tranches, and AI250 progress
Commentary on memory supply and Android OEM build plans for the December quarter
Automotive/IoT growth sustaining its ~28% combined pace
Pace of the Apple modem revenue decline
